items.html: Now, in this phase that clothes in the Vav Sefirot of the third Tevuna, there is the entirety of all the phases as will be explained, which are the three letters of Tzelem [Tzadi-Lamed-Mem]. Therefore this phase alone is called Tzelem, because all of them are included in it, even though they are only the Mem of Tzelem, as mentioned above. Thus this phase of Mem is like a surrounding light extending from its place to the whole of ZA, down to his feet.
